instruction.text: Decide if a line graph would be useful in these scenarios.

atoms.a: Steve wants to know what everyone’s favourite drink is.
Ali wants to take everyone’s pizza order.
Chandra wants to track how many miles she runs each day.

instruction.text: Maggie wants to track how many games of chess she wins every day. Select the three problems with the graph she constructed.

b: ++The line isn’t connected from day 5 to day 6.

instruction.text: Maggie has corrected her graph thanks to your help. Now answer these questions about it.

atoms.a: On what day did Maggie win the most games?
How many more games did Maggie win on day 4 than on day 1?
On how many days did Maggie win exactly 5 games?
